text: Ascendancies are a new way to develop your character in a more specified direction. These sub classes are available to any class and expand the possibility of builds greatly.
There are 14 ascendancies implemented at the moment.
textZh: 升华职业是发展角色的新方式，让角色向更专精的方向成长。这些子职业对所有职业开放，极大地拓展了构筑的可能性。
目前已实装 14 种升华职业。
title: About ascendancies

text: After defeating Baal for the first time in normal difficulty, he will drop Ascendancy Cairn alongside Ascendancy Soulstone of Tier 1 - Soulstone of Might.

To cycle through the available Ascendancies, just cube Soulstone of Might on its own. After you have decided which Ascendancy you want to advance with, cube Soulstone of Might with your Ascendancy Cairn. Ascendancy Cairn acts as any other talisman, so just keep it in your inventory.

Defeating Baal for the first time on Nightmare and Hell difficulties, will yield you Soulstones of Tier 2 and 3 respectively. Cube them with your Ascendancy Cairn to unlock more power of the sub-class of your choice.
To obtain final Soulstone and achieve complete ascension, you have to prove your strength by defeating any of the Ubers on any tier:
textZh: 首次在普通难度击败巴尔后,他将掉落升华石碑与 1 阶升华魂石——力量魂石。
若想切换可用的升华,只需将力量魂石单独放入方块。确定要进阶的升华后,将力量魂石与升华石碑一同放入方块。升华石碑与任何护符一样放入背包即可生效。
首次在噩梦与地狱难度击败巴尔,将分别获得 2 阶与 3 阶魂石。将其与升华石碑合成,可解锁所选修职业的更多力量。
要获得最终的灵魂石并完成全部升华，你需要在任意难度击败以下超级首领之一来证明自己的实力：
title: How to ascend

text: In order to respec, cube your Ascendancy Cairn with Token of Absolution. This will scour it and give you back all hard earned ascendancy stones.
textZh: 要重新分配升华点数，将升华石碑与赦免令牌一起放入方块。这将清除升华石碑并返还所有辛苦获得的升华石。
